UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK MAY HAVE BEEN UNDERESTIMATED DUE TO CLOUD COVER AND OTHER FALSE POSITIVES THAT MAY HAVE OBSCURED SECTIONS OF THE ANOMALY.
